svg.text: Every transition is authenticated, integrity-checked and recorded on a tamper-evident ledger
AI may raise, never lower, the
Secrets: Vault / AWS KMS, no keys in repo
Encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest
Zero-trust API: short-lived JWT + scoped roles
WAF + rate limiting on webhooks and APIs
★ Issues one-time apply token (plan hash bound)
★ Anchors Merkle root of expected state
★ CAUSAL RECEIPT — one verifiable chain per deployment
★ = proposed novel feature (check against literature before claiming novelty) T1–T5 = secured transitions
